plan.notes: B.S. Biology, Buchtel College of Arts & Sciences. Built from the official University of Akron Undergraduate Bulletin 'Recommended Sequence' (https://bulletin.uakron.edu/undergraduate/colleges-programs/arts-sciences/biology/biology-bs/). Requirements: General Education 36, College of Arts & Sciences requirements 8, Biology Core 47-50, Biology Electives 19, additional credits to 120. Biology electives: minimum 19 credits of 300/400-level biology courses beyond the core (excludes BIOL 311, BIOL 316, BIOL 470; up to 4 credits of independent research/Biological Problems). The official grid leaves the year 3-4 non-core slots unlabeled; this plan designates 19 credits of those slots as 300/400-level biology electives and models the rest as General Education/college requirement choices — documented here, not implied by the grid. Uses Akron's new course numbering. If not at precalculus level, postpone BIOL 111/112 and CHEM 151-154 to sophomore year and take social science/humanities first (per catalog note).
